mechanism: Fluphenazine may impair glucose control and antagonize liraglutide's antidiabetic effects through dopamine antagonism and metabolic effects; liraglutide may increase risk of extrapyramidal side effects and QT prolongation when combined with antipsychotics.
action: Monitor blood glucose levels closely, watch for worsening glycemic control, and assess for increased extrapyramidal symptoms; ECG monitoring recommended due to additive cardiac effects.
